name: A26 Dualling LiDAR Point Cloud — Glarryford to Ballymena (3D)
description: Airborne LiDAR point cloud of the full A26 Frosses/Glarryford dualling-scheme corridor (~8 km, Glarryford to Ballymena), streamed in 3D as an OGC 3D-Tiles octree built from all 217 survey tiles. Rendered with deck.gl interleaved into the map: tilt and zoom in and the individual scanned points load in place; zoom out and they unload. Level-of-detail streaming keeps performance bounded regardless of dataset size.
